abort_note: Some when a frame's view failed (the player lost or unreadable): frames stopped there, the engine still settled to the cut, and the digest is the state at the cut

decisions.note: scheduled at canonical ticks before the run; taken at those ticks, never at a wall-derived one
decisions.taken_note: the engine retains every taken decision (it is canonical state, hashed by the digest); summarised here, not printed

digest_note: the digest is taken at the canonical cut (cut_tick, a tick of the root clock): no frame advanced past it, and everything up to it is resolved (settle); two runs with one input log, one seed and one cut give one digest, paced or not, on any budget

frame_cpu_ms.note: the thread's CPU time per frame: the work without the waiting; a hitch in frame_ms that is not here was a stall (descheduled or paged), not computed
